The '''Geroon Nation''' was a nation that [[Potentate]] [[Tambocell]] was affiliated with. It partially shared its name with the<ref name="Endnotes">{{Blogspot|subdomain=geekosity|url=2010/04/endnotes-for-star-wars-unknown-regions.html|name=Daniel Wallace's Geekosity|text=Endnotes for Star Wars: The Unknown Regions|date=2010-04-20|quote=The pull-quote for this entry was dropped for lack of space.}}</ref> [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] [[Geroon (species)|Geroon]] [[Species/Legends|species]] and their [[Geroon|eponymous]] [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]].<ref name="OBF">[[Outbound Flight (novel)|''Outbound Flight'']]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Geroon Nation was set to be introduced in a pull-quote for the [[Ebruchi]] entry of the<ref name="Endnotes" /> [[2010]]<ref name="TUR">''[[The Unknown Regions]]''</ref> sourcebook ''[[The Unknown Regions]]'', published by [[Wizards of the Coast]] for the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]''; however, the quote was cut from the sourcebook due to lack of space.<ref name="Endnotes" />
